name: Voxel Simplification for LOD
definition: A method to approximate a triangular model to varying levels of detail using an incremental simplification of function values based on voxel grids. It decomposes function values hierarchically as a multi-resolution function, minimizing simplification error in the surface itself.
summary: Voxel Simplification for LOD converts triangular meshes into sparse voxel octrees using a novel error metric to dynamically adjust detail by viewer distance, avoiding pre-generated assets.
